prompt:
Create a high-fidelity MOBILE WEB APP UI design comp, portrait 390x1100 proportional canvas. It must look like an actual carefully art-directed Persian RTL product screen, not a photograph, phone mockup, poster or illustration. Product name کوچ / Kooch, a self-service preliminary immigration guidance tool for Persian speakers. CHOSEN immutable design world: contemporary architecture studio's working notebook, quietly premium, precise, generous breathing room, warm smooth paper-color #F6F4EF (no grain texture), navy ink #102D3E, restrained teal #237E80, white working surfaces, subtle neutral fine dividers, soft 12px control corners, one coherent Vazirmatn-like modern Persian sans. Keep Persian text legible and RTL, numeric text can be Persian digits. Use semantic-looking real native radio choices, no invented metrics, no progress percentage, no promises of admission/visa/funding, no testimonials, no travel stock photography. The existing logo is a navy Kooch wordmark with a small teal diagonal leaf detail, do not invent a different brand symbol. Mobile-first usability, strong 44px touch targets, calm hierarchy, clear focus/selection state, four-item bottom navigation labelled بررسی / پاسخ‌ها / کارنامه / حساب with consistent restrained line icons. Header at top has small Kooch wordmark and guide link. Real copy: headline «قدم بعدی مهاجرتت را روشن کن.»; supporting line «چند پاسخ کوتاه، چند مسیر برای بررسی.»; current question «برای چه هدفی می‌خواهی مهاجرت کنی؟»; real answer options «کار»، «تحصیل»، «پیوستن به خانواده»، «کارآفرینی»، «سرمایه یا درآمد مستقل»، «هنوز نمی‌دانم». Primary action «ثبت پاسخ و ادامه». Secondary action «دیدن خلاصه با همین پاسخ‌ها». A small disclosure says «این بررسی، تأیید شرایط یا احتمال ویزا نیست.». Include concise first-report notice «برای اولین کارنامه، تأیید عضویت تلگرام لازم است.». No top eyebrow label, no hero statistics, no gratuitous gradients, no generic green SaaS dashboard. Vary only composition, never palette, brand, typography voice or product function. Render enough down the scroll to show how the same system handles guidance detail.
COMPOSITION A: a focused working sheet. At top a spare brand row and the three actual stages «شرایط تو / پیش‌نیازهای مرتبط / مسیرها و قدم بعدی» with first stage active, visibly secondary. Then a confident large headline with careful Persian line wrapping. The current question lives in a broad white working panel occupying most of the view; six radio choices in a beautifully spaced two-column, three-row layout, selected «تحصیل» with a teal outline and native checked radio, no decorative icon tiles. Primary full-width navy button below with a small left arrow. A muted explanatory strip beneath says «لازم نیست از همین اول همه‌چیز را بدانی.» followed by three plain editorial rows for «مسیرهای مرتبط / چیزهایی که کم داری / یک قدم مشخص». This is calm, direct and unusually well-proportioned.
